admin.timeline.intro:
This screen allows you to configure various options for each notification, per application.
  • Notification choice:
    Allows you to restrict notifications so that they are published through a single channel, i.e. only in the activity feed or only by email.
  • Default email frequency:
    Sets the frequency configured by default for each user who has not yet changed their preferences.
